verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents that every document becomes part of the agent's knowledge base, with chat-with-your-docs and RAG out of the box. A hands-on user report on regulatory PDFs confirms answers were largely correct, though the citations window showed garbled content. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on supported document/note formats and ingestion, reliable citation rendering for grounded answers.

support.subject: As a power user, I can attach my own documents and notes as a knowledge base and get grounded answers over them

citations.quote: Every document becomes part of your agent's knowledge base with no data leaving your device.
RAG, agents, and work right out of the box
